subject: Run FeatureBench smoke and 15 instance pilot on Windows
description: Context from FB-5: do NOT run or prepare the full 200-instance FeatureBench split yet. Full split is gated until a measured pilot exists. Use the repo at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid on the native-x86 Windows/WSL2 runner with Docker and human-provided credentials. Verify/install Python 3.12 FeatureBench 0.2.1 in .venv-fb, apply the tracked patches in patches/ (or their Windows equivalent), and generate a gitignored .fb-infer-config.toml from the local credential source. Per note:note-mqiwte4ddob, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN can be forwarded through FeatureBench config by putting it under [env]; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is also acceptable if the user provides it. Use bench/featurebench-kb/pilot-manifest.json and the KB files in bench/featurebench-kb/. First run a 1-instance smoke (pandas-dev__pandas.82fa2715.test_col.a592871d.lv1) with the ON selflearn KB via FB_KB_PATH. If smoke is valid, run the 3-arm 15-instance fast pilot: OFF with no KB, sonnet KB, and selflearn KB. Collect output.jsonl/report.json paths, resolved rates, failures, runtime, and token/cost data. Record the measured pilot result in the graph and only then create/release a separate scale-to-full-split decision task if the pilot shows a clear positive signal. Do not fake results if Docker, credentials, or FeatureBench capacity are unavailable.
